installation.setup_principal: Separate synthetic admin, never the execution caller
installation.execution_principal: Normal tenant user, is_superuser=false and provider organization=false, one explicit role

transport.integration_requests: Real SDK POSTs forwarded to real API; integrations.get carries exact owned solution, get_mapping does not
transport.source_requests: Separate actual GET /api/sdk/modules/{owned deployment runtime source}; exact bytes and CachedModule hash, committed active attempt fence and signed caller/Solution checked
transport.model_vendor: Absent; no external calls or compatibility proof

acceptance: Static candidate only until supported Docker/CI reference and comparator validation; A-only does not complete C1-R or prove Rust authority

workspace_reconciliation.selected_A_B_source_diff: Empty git diff independently verified; original source commit/blob/hash retained
workspace_reconciliation.proof: Source reconciliation only; no runtime acceptance
